conventions.convention: Embedding distortion applies to squared Euclidean norms, with factors 1−ε and 1+ε and 0<ε<1.
An oblivious embedding succeeds separately for every fixed subspace chosen independently of the draw; it need not preserve all such subspaces simultaneously.
Sketch-and-solve calls the SVD solver at strict threshold zero with a finite sweep budget. Its minimizer guarantee is conditional on exact-arithmetic convergence and an exact SVD record.
The residual guarantee requires an embedding of span(Ran(A),{b}); embedding Ran(A) alone is insufficient.
Leverage scores use an orthonormal basis matrix of a positive-dimensional subspace, with row indices 0≤i<n.

Rows are sampled independently with replacement, with π_i≥βℓ_i/d and 0<β≤1, and rescaled by 1/sqrt(mπ_i). Zero-probability rows are never sampled; admissible distributions may assign positive probability to zero-leverage rows.
Normalized complex Gaussian entries have E|g|²=1. The Gaussian tail and embedding statements explicitly assume Countable Choice for their finite-dimensional probability laws.
The QR right preconditioner is R⁻¹ from SA=QR with Q*Q=I and nonsingular upper-triangular R; it preconditions the original matrix as AR⁻¹.

load_bearing.statement: S is an ε-subspace embedding for U when (1−ε)||x||₂²≤||Sx||₂²≤(1+ε)||x||₂² for every x∈U. An (ε,δ) oblivious embedding satisfies this with probability at least 1−δ for every fixed d-dimensional U chosen independently of the draw.
For a d-dimensional subspace U, d≥1, the row squared norms of any orthonormal basis matrix are basis-independent, satisfy 0≤ℓ_i≤1 and sum_i ℓ_i=d, and ℓ_i=0 exactly when row i is zero.

In exact arithmetic, if the zero-threshold SVD call converges and supplies an exact SVD record, the returned vector is the unique minimum-Euclidean-norm minimizer of ||SAx−Sb||₂, and the reported rank is rank(SA). No conclusion is asserted on an inconclusive or finite-precision unverified branch.
For Hermitian H∈K^(d×d), d≥1, a 1/4-net of the unit sphere exists with cardinality at most 9^d over R and 9^(2d) over C; every such net satisfies ||H||₂≤2 max_v |v*Hv|.
Assume Countable Choice. For m≥1 independent standard real or normalized complex Gaussian scalars and 0<t<1, Pr{|m⁻¹ sum_j |g_j|²−1|≥t}≤2 exp(−mt²/8).
If S embeds span(Ran(A),{b}) with squared-norm distortion ε and sketch-and-solve returns an exact-arithmetic converged vector x̂, then ||Ax̂−b||₂²≤((1+ε)/(1−ε)) min_x ||Ax−b||₂².
